svg.aria-label: WattOptimizer plan synced through intervals.icu to a bike computer
svg.text: From pacing plan to bike computer
WattOptimizer pushes the plan to intervals.icu as a workout with distance-based steps; intervals.icu syncs it to your device, which advances each step by distance.
Distance steps keep the targets tied to the
Planned feature: the --export intervals flag is on the roadmap and not implemented yet. Screen is an illustration, not any vendor's actual layout.
* Check COROS support for distance-based steps before race day. Multisport (triathlon) workouts on watches vary by model.
